summary: This Form 6-K reports a non-convertible debenture issuance by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company. The filing contains the indenture for the 9th issue of simple debentures, not convertible into shares, in a single series, under an automatic registration procedure for professional investors. There is no change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event. The debentures are a routine debt financing instrument, with terms standard for a public distribution without prior CVM analysis. This is a regular capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
